question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86f8cb989ae4e399d7f38aa08010a450d4b3e115eea9c184de309bd815d89c5b.png] 

In which year is the percentage increase in the revenue as compared to that in the preceding year the highest?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total revenue in 2014 = 260

Total revenue in 2015 = 300

Increase = (300 – 260) = 40

Percentage increase = (40/260 × 100)

⇒ 15.38%

Total revenue in 2015 = 300

Total revenue in 2016 = 340

Increase = (340 – 300) = 40

Percentage increase = (40/300 × 100)

⇒ 13.33%

Total revenue in 2016 = 340

Total revenue in 2017 = 350

Increase = (350 – 340) = 10

Percentage increase = (10/340 × 100)

⇒ 2.94%

Total revenue in 2017 = 350

Total revenue in 2018 = 375

Increase = (375 – 350) = 25

Percentage increase = (25/350 × 100)

⇒ 7.14%

**∴ The percentage increase in the revenue as compared to that in the preceding year the highest is 2015 **
